title: Rav Yeimar bar Shelemya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a student of Abaye. In [Bava Batra 63a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.63a.1) he says, “I myself had it explained to me by Abaye,” and in [Chullin 107b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.107b.20) he asks Abaye a question. Hyman cites [Shabbat 66b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.66b.20) and [Shabbat 156a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.156a.4), [Moed Katan 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.6b.16), [Sukkah 7b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.7b.8) and [Sukkah 35a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.35a.13), and Sotah 20b for reports in Abaye’s name.

Hyman says he also received teachings from Rava. In [Bava Batra 9a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.9a.3) he objects to Rava, who does not answer him. In [Menachot 31a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.31a.9) he sends Rav Pappa the statement of Ravin bar Chinana, etc. In [Berakhot 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.53b.22) he asks Mar Zutra, “Did Resh Lakish say this?” etc. Hyman says it is possible that he is Mar Zutra Rabba. [Ketubot 10b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.10b.11) has Rava bar Yishmael, or alternatively Rav Yeimar bar Shelemya, asking, “What verse supports this?” etc.[^4]

notes.text: The matching dispatch to Rav Papa is on the checked Menachot 31a, whereas Hyman supplies 31b. His possible Mar Zutra Rabba identification is retained as a possibility.

No new primary scalar was returned. Menachot 31a is the earlier recorded match beside supplied 31b, not a new whole-folio check. Hyman’s student-of-Abaye and received-from-Rava claims are attributed. ר״פ and ר״ל are contextual Papa and Resh Lakish readings, without a newly inspected full personal title; Papa is R-prime here. Hyman’s possible Mar Zutra Rabba equation remains ambiguous and tentative, not an identity binding. Rava bar Yishmael and Rav Yeimar remain alternative Ketubot attributions; Ravin bar Chinana retains his own name, not an inferred full Rav title.

The consulted Bava Batra 9a gives Yeimar’s objection and Rava’s silence, followed by Rav Pappa’s explanation. Bava Batra 63a and Chullin 107b show Yeimar receiving a clarification from Abaye and asking him a question. Shabbat 66b and 156a, Moed Katan 6b, and Sukkah 7b expressly name Abaye as the source. Sukkah 35a, continuing onto 35b, gives the statement about matzah and challah alternatively to Rabba bar Shmuel or Yeimar, without naming Abaye there. The bounded check around Sotah 20b did not recover the cited attribution. In the consulted Menachot 31a, Yeimar sends the question to Rav Pappa. The discussion continues into 31b. Berakhot 53b also gives Rav Yeimar bar Sheizevi as an alternate questioner. In Ketubot 10b the consulted text gives Rava bar Rabbi Yishmael or Rav Yeimar bar Shelemya. The possible Mar Zutra Rabba identification remains Hyman’s suggestion.

The consulted Sukkah 35a names Yeimar or Rabbah bar Shmuel without an attribution to Abaye. Menachot’s question cites Ravin bar Chinana transmitting through Ulla in Rabbi Chanina’s name. Heilprin also places the dispatch to Rav Pappa at 31a. Hyman’s printed locator is 31b. See [Heilprin’s corresponding entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2051&lang=en).
